open_leads.title: MONAI Label fix status: was a patched release published?
open_leads.note: BleepingComputer says a security update on 18 Nov; Startup Fortune (relaying SecurityWeek) says fix merged in source, no release. GitHub advisory returned 403 and Amazon's blog (https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/security/chinese-nexus-actors-cairn-ai-agents-found-a-zero-day-on-their-own/) returned only navigation. Read the advisory or SecurityWeek and settle it; also give The Record source its published day.

open_leads.title: Santos port authority: report that APS was in the final phase of restoring administrative systems around 16 Nov
open_leads.note: Seen only in a search summary, not on a page read; the record was not changed. Also: Agência Brasil (10 Nov) quotes APS saying it could not determine whether data was accessed, which sits beside the record's 18 Nov 'no confidential data leaked' (ABC do ABC); the reviewer may want both stated.

notes: MONAI: Startup Fortune contradicts BleepingComputer on the fix release; both accounts now given, action points to the advisory, correction file 2026-11-23-cairn-ai-monai-label-zero-day.json. Startup Fortune also says the attacks ran in September and affected 0.8.5 and earlier (relaying The Hacker News); versions were not added because the advisory could not be read. Santos: no reporting newer than 18 Nov found; unchanged.
